about.title: Tradition that becomes an experience
about.p1: Figata Cafe is a cozy neighborhood coffee shop in Vyronas for good specialty coffee, natural fig products, and authentic Greek flavors. In a quiet corner we created a small cafe from a love of coffee, wholesome food, and the aromas of Greek soil. It began with the dried fig of Taxiarches, Evia — a small fruit full of memory, flavor, and care.
about.p2: Here every drink and every bite has a reason to exist. Our aim is everyday moments of pleasure and hospitality in a warm, cozy place in Vyronas — always with a smile.

items.a: At Agias Sofias 128, Vyronas 16232 — a cozy neighborhood cafe for good coffee and a quiet break.
Specialty coffee and drinks, natural dried figs from Taxiarches in Evia, handmade creations, and local flavors.

items.q: Is it a good cozy place for coffee in Vyronas?
items.a: Yes. Figata is a small, cozy cafe in a quiet corner of Vyronas — ideal for good coffee, relaxation, and authentic flavors.
Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday 07:00–19:00; Tuesday 07:00–15:00; Saturday 08:00–15:00; Sunday 09:00–15:00.

items.q: Do you sell natural fig products?
items.a: Yes. We offer pure Greek dried figs and related products with a taste of tradition — great for everyday enjoyment or gifts.
